description: This file defines a C# interface ILogTestGrain used for testing log-consistency providers within the Orleans framework. It includes various asynchronous methods for retrieving, setting, and updating data related to test grains, as well as a struct AB used to return multiple values.

classes.name: AB
classes.description: A serializable struct that contains two integer fields, A and B, used by ILogTestGrain to return multiple values.

methods.name: GetAGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves the value of A from the global state.

methods.name: GetALocal
methods.description: Retrieves the value of A from the local state.

methods.name: GetBothGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B from the global state.

methods.name: GetBothLocal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B from the local state.

methods.name: GetReservationsGlobal
methods.description: Gets the array of reservations in the global state.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the confirmed version number.

methods.name: SetAGlobal
methods.description: Sets the value of A in the global state.

methods.name: SetAConditional
methods.description: Sets the value of A conditionally, returning a tuple indicating success.

methods.name: SetALocal
methods.description: Sets the value of A in the local state.

methods.name: IncrementALocal
methods.description: Increments the local value of A.

methods.name: IncrementAGlobal
methods.description: Increments the global value of A.

methods.name: SetBGlobal
methods.description: Sets the value of B in the global state.

methods.name: SetBLocal
methods.description: Sets the value of B in the local state.

methods.name: AddReservationLocal
methods.description: Adds a reservation to the local reservations list.

methods.name: RemoveReservationLocal
methods.description: Removes a reservation from the local reservations list.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the current state as a key-value pair.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the grain state with a list of updates if the expected version matches.

methods.name: GetEventLog
methods.description: Returns the event log of the grain.

methods.name: SynchronizeGlobalState
methods.description: Synchronizes the global state.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain.
